Constraints: Stylized educational illustration. No text or letters, UI, flags, logos, watermark, postcard frame or stamp. No flower carpet festival, Atomium, cathedral, fairy castle, unrelated landmark or invented geography.
inspection: Inspected: ornate guildhall gables with gold details, a long asymmetric Gothic Town Hall and one tall delicate spire around a cobbled square.
